stem.text: A battery of negligible internal resistance is connected in series with a thermistor and a fixed resistor of resistance $12.0\,\text{k}\Omega$, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a battery in series with a thermistor and a 12.0 kΩ resistor; output terminals labelled Vout across the 12.0 kΩ resistor.

stem.text: The table shows the resistance of the thermistor at two different temperatures.
